svg.title: Registered studies of the face or skin in GLP-1 users
svg.desc: 10 ClinicalTrials.gov studies enroll people on GLP-1 drugs and measure the face or skin. 9 test a cosmetic treatment: 5 fillers or biostimulators, 2 devices and 2 topical serums. One is an identical-twin imaging study. None has posted results, and none compares the drug with the same weight loss without it.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Most “Ozempic face” studies test fixes, not the cause
